ActorTalk: People used to love listening to music like this—on a quiet afternoon, during a bus ride, or on a rainy day.
In stories, it's always two people, one pair of earbuds, one song. The feelings they can't say aloud, the silent look in their eyes—everything gets passed along through that short wire between them.
Then maybe we should try it sometime too.
Time spent with someone special is always unforgettable.
This gallery event follows a similar idea. The WGAA wants people to create something with someone special—something that belongs to both.
You already know who I had in mind, don't you?
The person I want to create with... is standing right in front of me.
Looks like we feel the same way.
The gallery's prepared all sorts of activities. So... just like always, I'll let you decide, Conductor.
